title: Eleven Metres of Aluminium
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：wing　|　正文 312 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wing 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was a bird with a broken ① wing in the hedge in 1940, and my father, who was eleven, took it home, and it died on the second day, and the wing had been broken by nothing at all; he said that was the first thing the war taught him and the only one he never forgot.

The ② wing of the bomber they were working on was eleven metres of aluminium, and three men could lift it, and my father said the oddest thing about it was how light it was, and the wing came off in 1943.

The ③ wing of the house, the part built in 1931, was where the eleven men were billeted, three at a time, and my grandmother cooked for them and never learned any of their names. My grandfather was on the ④ left wing of the village committee, which in 1942 meant he wanted the men paid, and he was outvoted eleven times and kept coming.

He played on the ⑤ wing for the village until 1939, and he said the whole of football is knowing when not to run, which is also, he said, the whole of everything else. In 1944 my grandmother took a girl from the next street under her ⑥ wing, and the girl stayed eleven years, and nobody ever explained why.

In 1953, when they asked him to speak at the memorial, he ⑦ winged it, and my mother said it was the worst eleven minutes anybody had ever sat through and also the only honest one. Birds ⑧ winged over the field at dawn in June, and he said the ⑨ wing of a bird is the only machine ever made that mends itself. The ⑩ wing, meaning the one off the aircraft, is in the museum at the county town: I have stood under it, and it is eleven metres long, and it is very light.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: D. n. （政党、组织内的）翼；派系（left / right wing）
E. n. （足球等的）边锋；侧翼位置
F. v. 飞行；飞过（文学用法）
G. 固定搭配：take ... under one's wing 庇护；照料
H. 固定搭配：wing it 临时应付；即兴发挥

items.q: a bird with a broken wing
The wing of the bomber they were working
The wing of the house, the part built
on the left wing of the village committee
He played on the wing for the village
under her wing, and the girl stayed
he winged it, and my mother said
Birds winged over the field at dawn

answers.why: a broken wing 意为“受伤的翅膀”，1940 年树篱里有只翅膀受伤的鸟，父亲十一岁，把它带回了家。
the wing of the bomber 意为“轰炸机的机翼”，那机翼是十一米长的铝，三个人就能抬起来。
the wing of the house 意为“房子的侧翼、厢房”，1931 年建的那一部分，十一个人分批住在那里。
the left wing 意为“左翼、左派”，1942 年他在村委员会里属左翼，意思是他主张给那些人发工钱。
on the wing 意为“（踢）边锋”，他直到 1939 年都在村里队上踢边锋。
take ... under one's wing 意为“把……置于自己的庇护之下、照料”，1944 年祖母把邻街的一个女孩收留在身边。
wing it 意为“临时应付、即兴发挥”，1953 年他们请他在纪念仪式上讲话，他是即兴讲的。
winged 是动词（文学用法），意为“飞、飞过”，六月的黎明，鸟群从田野上空飞过。
the wing of a bird 意为“鸟的翅膀”，他说鸟的翅膀是唯一会自己修好的机器。
the wing 意为“机翼”，指从飞机上拆下来的那片机翼，如今在郡城的博物馆里。
